positionGuide.label: POSITION GUIDE
positionGuide.text: Stand sideways to the camera. Keep your full body visible from head to toe. Camera should be at knee height, ~1.5 m away.

error.denied: Camera permission denied. On iPhone: Settings ▸ Safari ▸ Camera ▸ Ask/Allow, or tap «aA» in the address bar ▸ Website Settings ▸ Camera.
error.notFound: No camera found on this device.
error.inUse: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
error.overconstrained: The selected camera is no longer available. Tap SET and pick another one.
error.unsupported: This browser does not allow camera access. Open the link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android) — in-app browsers such as Instagram will not work.
error.unknown: Could not start the camera. Reload the page and try again.
